title: Satellites Found 1.5 Million Penguins by Spotting Their Poop

scenes.text: Satellites found 1.5 million penguins by spotting their poop.
Adelie penguins nest on the same rocks every year.
Their droppings stain the ground pink, from all the krill they eat.
Those stains are big enough to show up on NASA's Landsat images.
That led scientists to the Danger Islands, off the tip of Antarctica.
The colony there is bigger than the rest of the Peninsula combined.

description:
Satellites found 1.5 million penguins by spotting their poop.
Pink guano stains on Antarctic rocks show up in Landsat images. They led scientists to the Danger Islands, home to about 1.5 million Adelie penguins.
What's the weirdest way you've found something? Tell us below.
first_comment: White guano means mostly fish. Pink means mostly krill. Which would you rather clean?
